name: AIKit-Arduino
sentence: One-stop Arduino client for OpenAI-compatible chat completion APIs (19 vendor presets incl. Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, ModelScope, Ollama, vLLM...) plus cloud speech-to-text: one-shot HTTP transcription and WebSocket real-time ASR.
paragraph: Built on StreamHTTPClient and ArduinoJson v7. One begin() call per vendor. Chat: sync & SSE streaming, token usage statistics, auto retry with exponential backoff, conversation history with JSON export/import. ASR: 8 transcription vendors (OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, Zhipu GLM-ASR, DashScope fun-asr-flash/Qwen-ASR, StepFun, Xiaomi MiMo, FunASR self-hosted) and 7 realtime WebSocket vendors (Volcengine Seed-ASR, DashScope paraformer, Baidu, FunASR, OpenAI Realtime, StepFun, Mistral) via the optional ArduinoWebsockets dependency.
note: StreamHTTPClient is not yet published in the Arduino Library Manager; install it from https://github.com/ioqit/StreamHTTPClient (see README). Realtime ASR additionally needs the optional ArduinoWebsockets library.
